title: Drive-Through Food Distributions
description: Feeding the Flock SD hosts drive-through food distributions designed to make support convenient, respectful, and easy to access. Families remain in their cars while volunteers load food boxes directly into their trunks.
points: Food boxes may include proteins, vegetables, fruit, canned goods, and staple items
Neighbors can pick up for others when needed, helping food reach more households
Distribution days are built around dignity, kindness, and practical care

title: Santee Senior Pantry
description: The Santee Senior Pantry gives older adults a welcoming, dignified way to access nutritious food. Seniors can choose grocery items that fit their needs, rather than receiving only a pre-packed box.
points: Set up like a small, friendly grocery-style pantry
Volunteers help with questions, carrying items, and practical support
Delivery may be available for housebound seniors when arranged

title: Emergency Pantry
description: Feeding the Flock SD helps provide emergency food assistance through a pantry at the La Mesa Veterans' Club for neighbors facing urgent or unexpected needs.
points: Offers support when food needs cannot wait for a regular distribution
Helps people facing difficult or sudden circumstances
Provides a local point of care in partnership with the La Mesa Veterans' Club

title: Homeless Outreach
description: Our homeless outreach provides practical care for people experiencing homelessness, including food, basic supplies, and compassionate connection.
points: May include meals, hygiene supplies, clean socks, and other essentials
Uses food and basic care as a bridge to trust and conversation
Helps connect people with partner resources when possible

title: School Partnerships
description: Feeding the Flock SD partners with a local school to help provide food support for students and families who may need extra help.
points: Supports children and families through trusted school connections
Helps food reach students in a familiar community setting
Extends care through practical, relationship-based support

title: Mexico Outreach
description: Feeding the Flock SD also supports missionary and charity work in Mexico, extending care through food assistance, children's programs, and outreach.
points: Reflects the organization's faith-based desire to serve
Supports care beyond local county lines
Connects local generosity with cross-border outreach
